class.name: HTMLClipboardEvent
class.brief_description: A copy, cut, or paste event.
class.description: The [member clipboard_data] payload is limited to [code]text/plain[/code]. Cancelling [code]paste[/code] prevents the default insertion; cancelling [code]cut[/code] prevents deletion of the selected text.

members.member: The text payload available to the clipboard handler.
